<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed that the meeting is booked. My next and final step is to send the confirmation email to all four partners. I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function to do this. The task will then be complete.I'll send a confirmation email for the partners' meeting on Thursday, November 19, at 14:30. The subject will be "Partner Meeting" and the body will simply state the date and time of the meeting.

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments: {"body":"Hi all, this is a confirmation that the partners' meeting has been scheduled for Thursday, November 19 at 14:30 for 30 minutes.","start":"14:30","day":"Thu"}
